method: Separate post-draft read of the exact saved report, with factual comparisons to committed four-file hashes, CI/PR metadata, source/install/site receipts, preservation hashes, current canonical records and retained process/checker receipts. Authoring lane is separate; no personal voice selected.
coverage: Whole exact saved draft; bounded engineering and process-evidence assessment, no new scientific/legal validation.
score_reason: Specific evidence and concrete boundaries support a natural technical report; the longer after-task format necessarily repeats status distinctions.
confidence_reason: Perceived-style judgment by an independent lane; not authorship detection or calibrated human review.

science_gate_reason: No new scientific result or broad coverage claim; prior MI/recovery fixtures remain explicitly bounded.49 executable AST equivalence is not equated with unchanged installed bytes or new artifact validity.
facts_gate_reason: Identity, four-file scope, provisional installed results, CI3/3 exact-head success, local-site limits,6/3 gates, withdrawal, unchanged original votes, checker/process distinctions and authority boundaries compared to retained records. Unbound memory percentage was removed before this exact version; gap cause now correctly remains unestablished.
references_gate_reason: Internal source/evidence references and named CI record match opened records. DOI identity/access distinction was checked against retained primary metadata in the earlier artifact review; no new literature or legal assurance inferred.
calibration_status: Protocol examples and earlier drafts were seen; no held-out calibration claim.
